resources.string: The network changed - restarting the server on %1$s
Install downloads Node.js, git and VirtualTabletop. It needs an internet connection once - after that the server runs offline.
Start the server and open the room on any device in the same network.

Just want to play? Open virtualtabletop.io in a browser - that is the game itself, always up to date, and it needs no app at all.

This app is for playing with no internet around. It runs the VirtualTabletop server on this phone, so the phone, a tablet and a laptop on the same WiFi - or on this phone's hotspot - can play together on a train, in a garden or anywhere else offline.

Install fetches Node.js, git and VirtualTabletop once. That needs a connection and about 750 MB of storage, and everything it does is printed here. It can be pressed again to carry on if the connection breaks. Start server then hands out the address the other devices open.
